central_invariant: An unauthenticated container sharing the legitimate worker's Linux UID/GID, public signed TEST grant, and Unix socket cannot invoke the local mock sink if it lacks the per-run worker-session key. Even the legitimate worker must answer a broker-fresh random challenge with an HMAC bound to the complete proposal, then pass the existing independently pinned Ed25519 grant and durable single-use claim.
session_key: 256-bit synthetic per-run, generated by trusted host, broker private directory mode 0700, key file mode 0444 mounted read-only only into legitimate worker, never mounted to same-UID impersonator
challenge: fresh CSPRNG 256 bits for each accepted allowed-UID connection
mac: HMAC-SHA256 over domain separator, raw 32-byte fresh broker nonce, SHA-256 of canonical complete request+approval envelope
trusted_operator_key: test-only generated locally, no external enrollment
broker_id: non-root host runner UID/GID inside separate network-none broker Docker container
nonclaims: This is per-worker session-key possession, not attested unique process or immutable container identity
